newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica fined for data misuse, to appeal.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica fined for data misuse, to appeal.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana said on Wednesday that it was fined by the Data Protection Agency for misuse of client data and was going to appeal this decision.
Telefonica and its advertising unit Telefonica Publicidad e Informacion were fined 110 million pesetas on June 6 for using private client information for advertising purposes.
Telefonica, which will file the appeals with Madrid's Superior Tribunal, said the information concerned was already in the public domain and therefore Telefonica could legally use it.

"Telefonica understands, among other reasons, that the data in question could be gathered from sources accessible to the public and, as a result, such activity would scrupulously adhere to the active legislation on the treatment of data of a private nature," Telefonica said in a statement.
